messages:
Lina: hi folks — orientation shows up twice on my calendar (one says 'Orientation' at 9am PST, another 'Orientation (Global)' at 9am local). My Apple Calendar picked the PST one and now it's at 9pm for me. Which is correct? also zoom asks for a passcode i can't find. :confused:
Omar (People Ops): hey Lina, sorry about that. We had a bad recurring series and a one-off global event. The canonical event is 'Orientation (Global)'. Accept that one. I removed the older recurring series this morning. :wave:
Lina: i accepted Global but my calendar still shows the PST one as 'busy' and it's blocking that time — how do i remove the ghost event?
Diego (IT): Apple Calendar will sometimes keep the old event if it was subscribed from ICS. Quick fix:
```
1) Open Calendar app -> Calendar List
2) Uncheck any 'Subscribed' calendars (look for name like 'Onboarding events')
3) Restart Calendar -> re-add the single ICS from the onboarding email
```
If you want, I can send you a clean ICS that has no recurrence metadata. DM me.
Lina: that would be great — DM sent. also, the event description on mobile is truncated so i can't find the zoom passcode or the caption/transcript policy. are recordings captioned?
Jamie (Onboarding): Recording is automatic for the Global event and captions/transcript are enabled. We upload captions (VTT) to the folder and OnboardBot posts the link. For mobile truncation: open the event in the web calendar view (calendar.redwood.com) or the full calendar app on desktop. We'll also paste the passcode in the Slack thread to help mobile folks.
Omar (People Ops): passcode (for this event): 482911 — also note: if your org SSO prompts you repeatedly, contact Diego and we'll whitelist the redirect.
Diego (IT): sent you a one-off ICS with no passcode embedded and a join URL that bypasses the external passcode prompt. If anyone else needs it, DM me.
Lina: thanks! can we get the slide deck and a short list of topics covered? want to skim before joining.
Jamie (Onboarding): slide deck + agenda: https://redwood.com/onboarding/slides/1987659000-orientation-deck.pdf — covers: company mission, product overview, teams/org map, benefits, first-week checklist, who-to-ask. We'll also do a quick live Q&A at the end.
OnboardBot: Recording + captions uploaded: https://redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/1987659000-orientation.mp4 ; captions: https://redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/1987659000-orientation.vtt
Lina: perfect, thanks everyone — that clears it up. i'll join the APAC-friendly repeat if available next week. :smile:
Omar (People Ops): great — APAC repeat sign-up is on the slide deck link. Welcome aboard! :tada:
